resources.string: Point LEVI at the machine serving your LEVI web client, then come back here.
Load failed: %1$s. Check the server URL and that your machine is reachable.
Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https:// (empty clears it).
Plain http:// is only allowed for on-device servers (http://127.0.0.1). For a LAN or remote server, use its https:// URL.

On your computer, run the LEVI web client (in the repo: cd web && npm run dev), then enter its https:// URL here. Plain http:// only works for an on-device server (http://127.0.0.1); for a LAN machine, serve it over TLS (e.g. a Caddy reverse proxy) or expose it with a tunnel (e.g. cloudflared) and use the https:// tunnel URL. Full steps: docs/ANDROID_APP.md
